text:
- Finn, Pia, Dell, Ada, Jonah, Cora, Rafe: Desk swaps this week.
- Esme, Pia, Bram, Dell: Want north office and print room kept clear for visitors.
- Evening stand-up: Moved to north office.
- Lifts: Near loading bay and library annex are slow.
- Garmere fleet fuel allowance: 1,650.
- East wing: Umbrella present; being repainted; expect afternoon noise; too cold in morning.
- Print room: Being repainted; expect evening noise; coffee machine working; too cold in morning (Leon).
- Garden studio: Umbrella present; coffee machine working.
- Library annex: Umbrella present; coffee machine working.
- Action: Send Finn notes from morning meeting.
- Kira: Asked if north office is free in morning; thinks harbour room is too cold in evening.
- Greta: Out; covered by Vik; asked if loading bay is free in afternoon.
- Wren: Out; covered by Ines.
- Rafe: Out; covered by Vik.
- Teo: Out for rest of week; covered by Vik.
- Ines: Covered Wren; thinks loading bay is too cold in morning.
- Mira: Thinks loading bay is too cold in morning.
- Opal: Asked if harbour room is free in evening.
- Bram: Asked if east wing is free in evening.
